caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a woven seat. The chair has a rectangular backrest with two horizontal slats and vertical side supports. The wood is depicted in shades of brown, with darker and lighter brown tones to indicate shaded and highlighted areas. The woven seat is rendered in a light tan color with a detailed, crisscrossing pattern. The legs of the chair are turned and decorated with lighter, tan-colored rings or bands at intervals. The chair is illustrated on a plain, off-white or beige background, with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The overall composition centers the chair in the frame, and the style appears flat, with simple shading and no attempt at a three-dimensional perspective.
title: Side Chair
